questions.question: In John's vision of heaven, what did the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures do after the great crowd shouted Hallelujah?

answers.text: Stood at a distance and wept

questions.question: In John's vision, a great multitude in heaven shouts Hallelujah and says what event has come?
In John's vision of the Lamb's wedding, what does the bride's bright and pure fine linen stand for?

answers.text: The righteous acts of the saints
The riches of the great city
The prayers of the twenty-four elders

questions.question: When John fell at an angel's feet to worship him, the angel allowed it. True or false?
